title: AntiDoubleBlastProtection
description: Automatically re-enchants armor pieces with blast protection to protection, excluding the leggings. This essentially removes blast protection stacking. Known as "DBP" in Crystal PvP.
body:
# AntiDoubleBlastProtection (1.0)

### **🔹 Description:**

Automatically removes blast protection stacking by replacing Blast Protection enchantments on all armor except leggings with normal Protection at the configured level. Helps balance Crystal PvP by preventing 0 knockback due to multiple blast protection pieces. Often called "DBP" in Crystal PvP.

### **🌎 Features:**
- Checks all armor slots: helmet, chestplate, boots, leggings.
- Respects allow-leggings-blast configuration to exempt leggings.
- Automatically replaces offending enchantments with configurable Protection levels.
- Sends action-bar and chat messages with custom cooldowns.
- Plays a custom sound when a violation is detected.
- Full MiniMessage & hex color support for messages.
- Configurable per slot, sounds, messages, cooldowns, and replacement levels.
- Permissions for bypassing checks.
  
### **🤖 Commands:**

/adbp reload - Reloads the plugin configuration without restarting the server.

### **🏆 Permissions:**

`adbp.reload` - Allows you to run /adbp reload.

`adbp.bypass` - Bypasses the plugin.

Example video - https://imgur.com/KwQGthE
